mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_resource (user_id, goal_id, title, type, source_url, description, tags) VALUES (#{userId}, #{goalId}, #{title}, #{type}, #{sourceUrl}, #{description}, #{tags})
mapper.update: UPDATE learning_resource SET goal_id=#{goalId}, title=#{title}, type=#{type}, source_url=#{sourceUrl}, description=#{description}, tags=#{tags}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id}
